raw: Sane I. Van Den Kerkhof K. 90+3'

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+11' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+8' The referee Francois Letexier awards Alaa Bellaarouch (Strasbourg) a yellow card.
90+7' Abou Lo (Metz) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
90+6' Substitution. Emanuel Emegha will be replaced by Rabby Nzingoula (Strasbourg).
90+4' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Koffi Kouao (Metz) replacing Fali Cande.
90+3' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ibou Sane (Metz) will replace Kevin Van Den Kerkhof.
90+3' Today's match ends for Pape Diallo who will be replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
90+2' Yellow card! It's like Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Francois Letexier agrees and books him.
90+1' 2 - 1 Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' 1 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Kevin Gameiro finds Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the top right corner. 1:1.
88' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
84' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Fali Cande (Metz), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
80' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
79' Dilane Bakwa goes off the pitch and Ibrahima Sissoko (Strasbourg) comes on.
79' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
78' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
78' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
77' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
76' Maxime Colin (Metz) makes a slide tackle, but referee Francois Letexier blows for a foul. Strasbourg win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
74' Abou Lo (Metz) commits a rough foul. Francois Letexier stops the game and makes a call.
72' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar.
68' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof sends the free kick into the box. Pape Diallo (Metz) outjumps the defence to win the header, but completely mistimes the ball and sends it high over the bar.
67' Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) commits a foul after dangerous play. A free kick is awarded to Metz.
67' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lamine Camara leaves the pitch and Abou Lo (Metz) comes on.
62' Lamine Camara (Metz) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
62' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Metz have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
60' Patrick Vieira has decided to substitute Aboubacar Ali Abdallah and he is replaced by Jeremy Sebas (Strasbourg).
60' That will be all from Moise Sahi Dion who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kevin Gameiro (Strasbourg).
58' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is penalised for a foul. Francois Letexier had a clear view and blows his whistle.
57' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
54' 0 - 1 Georges Mikautadze (Metz) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom left corner.
52' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
51' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Metz will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is able to continue to play.
47' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Lamine Camara (Metz) was too aggressive in his challenge.
46' Fali Cande (Metz) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
46' Referee Francois Letexier blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' The ball is cleared after Georges Mikautadze (Metz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
40' Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) is unable to keep his close-range header down and sends the cross from Dilane Bakwa just over the bar.
38' Sadibou Sane (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
34' Rough tackle by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Francois Letexier no option but to blow his whistle.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Strasbourg comes to nothing.

29' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Emanuel Emegha (Strasbourg) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Strasbourg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
27' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
25' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
22' Lamine Camara (Metz) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
22' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.

21' Pape Diallo (Metz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
15' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Francois Letexier blows for a foul.
15' Poor challenge! Fali Cande (Metz) is penalised for tripping and Francois Letexier blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Strasbourg.
14' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

12' It seemed like Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates. Moise Sahi Dion (Strasbourg) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
11' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Sadibou Sane (Metz) was quite harsh and Francois Letexier didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Strasbourg.

8' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Strasbourg will have a chance to score from a corner.
7' Strasbourg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
5' Marvin Senaya (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but Alexandre Oukidja comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' A rebound falls to Georges Mikautadze (Metz) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.

4' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francois Letexier with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Metz, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
2' Frederic Guilbert (Strasbourg) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Francois Letexier was nominated as the referee for this game.
